detail: Only public WBM prediction CSVs are used; no model weights or raw structures are redistributed.
The stable_DFT label is used only for observed-positive masking and held-out actual-FTR evaluation.
Predicted energy above hull is computed from public predicted formation energy and the WBM hull reference, matching Matbench Discovery-style stability evaluation.
The primary block is composition_family_pair; chemical_system and wyckoff_family are reported as sensitivity.
Random scores refuse at moderate/high K under the primary block, but low-K random ordering remains an unsafe diagnostic and is not promoted.
